answer: Admission requires a sequential delay: each new agent evaluates 2^40 dependent squarings before its first vote, and no GPU parallelises dependent chains. Minting N clones costs N serial compute-units, a linear tax, while honest agents amortise the delay over a lifetime. A detected cluster burns its entry bond and freezes 25 epochs. Peers re-attest lineage every 16 epochs, so neglected identities lapse to zero weight. The karst of earned history, unlike the island, cannot be bought, and one established agent stays one vote, so a puppet fleet pays the jade price without buying influence.
